{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')
# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
# Remove QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]
# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
df_new_paid_search = df_clean[(df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search')]
# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
conversion_rate = df_new_paid_search['converted'].mean()
# Print the exact numbers used in the answer
print("Number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH:")
print(len(df_new_paid_search))
print("Conversion rate (fraction converted):")
print(conversion_rate)"}
